title_sq: Shesim Apartment 3+1 ne rezidencen prestigioze "UNICO", Bllok!
description_sq:
Ne zemer te Tiranes, ne nje nga zonat me elitare dhe me te kerkuara te qytetit - Blloku, ofrohet per shitje apartment 3+1 ne rezidencen prestigioze UNICO, e pozicionuar ne Rrugen Nikolle Tupe.
Rezidenca UNICO ishte nje godine moderne banimi dhe sherbimi 11-katëshe, me 4 kate parkimi nentokesor, e konceptuar sipas standardeve me te larta arkitektonike dhe urbane, duke nderthurur funksionalitetin, estetiken dhe cilesine superiore te ndërtimit.
Detaje te prones:
* Tipologjia: 3+1
* Kati: 4
* Orientimi: Jug-Lindje
* Siperfaqe neto: 118.6 m2
* Sipërfaqe e perbashket: 15.7 m2
* Siperfage bruto: 134.3 m2
*Planimetri e rregullt
*3 Ashensore total
Organizimi i apartamentit: Sallon dhe kend gatimi, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, ballkon.
Apartmenti ndodhet ne nje lokacion premium, me akses te menjehershem ne sherbime, institucione, bare, restorante dhe qendrat kryesore te biznesit te Tiranes, duke e bere nje zgjedhje ideale si per banim ashtu edhe per investim.
Per nje vizite ne prone me kontaktoni!
title_en: We sell Apartment 3+1 in the prestigious residence "UNICO", Block!
description_en: In the heart of Tirana, in one of the most elite and sought-after areas of the city - Blloku, a 3+1 apartment is offered for sale in the prestigious UNICO residence, located on Nikolle Tupe Street. The UNICO residence was a modern 11-story residential and service building, with 4 underground parking floors, conceived according to the highest architectural and urban standards, combining functionality, aesthetics and superior construction quality. Property details: * Typology: 3+1 * Floor: 4 * Orientation: South-East * Net area: 118.6 m2 * Common area: 15.7 m2 * Gross area: 134.3 m2 * Regular floor plan * 3 total elevator Organization of the apartment: Living room and kitchenette, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, balcony. The apartment is located in a premium location, with immediate access to services, institutions, bars, restaurants and the main business centers of Tirana, making it an ideal choice for both residence and investment. For a visit to the property, contact me!
